incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT DETECTED: GPU scheduling backlog + autoscale failures (queue growth) — paging oncall (5055550000)
kim_sre: I’m oncall, pinging in. seeing steady queue growth on production inference queues. getting repeated "allocations throttled" from scheduler.
alex_runtime: can you paste the allocator logs? I saw similar before when MIG slices were mis-sized after a cluster restart.
tara_ml: FYI models affected: text-gen-3b and embedder-v2, high QPS customers see increased latency.
devon_infra: alert shows autoscaler attempted to scale at 04:12:07 but hit max_replicas=120 for gpu-pool-prod-eu. scale request count spiked.
kim_sre: logs: ```
[allocator] 2026-03-15T04:12:07Z ERROR scale: request denied reason=QuotaExceeded max_replicas=120 current=120
[placer] 2026-03-15T04:12:08Z WARN placement: fragment=0.68 mig_mismatch=true stray_slots=42
[queue] 2026-03-15T04:12:09Z INFO queue: pending=182 growth_rate=+12/min
```
alex_runtime: looks like fragmentation + some MIG instances not fully usable (stranded slots). placer logs show many small free segments that can’t satisfy typical pod MIG requirements.
kim_sre: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) temporarily raise max_replicas for the pool, 2) trigger emergency repack to consolidate stranded slices, 3) evict best-effort batch jobs. which is fastest?
devon_infra: raising max_replicas needs approval from cost control, but we can +10 replicas for 30m as emergency. repack is heavier and may take 6-12m and causes churn. evicting batch is quickest (we have ~20 BE jobs).
sam_ic: we should do evict -> raise -> repack sequence. Nina, what's customer impact?
nina_cx: from telemetry, 7 paying customers have >5% request error/latency spikes: AcmeHealth, FluxPay, Scribely, NovaDocs, EchoAI, BrightForms, HelixRetail. I'll open a status page draft.
eli_pm: flagging AcmeHealth as priority (SLA customer). We need ETA to reduce errors under 1%
tara_ml: model routing fallback can route small requests to smaller models to reduce load. But embedding workload is bursty.
kim_sre: executing eviction and temporary scale up now. commands: ```bash
# mark BE jobs for eviction
redwood job cancel --tag=batch --pool=gpu-pool-prod-eu --grace=30s
# bump pool target
redwood pools update gpu-pool-prod-eu --max-replicas=130 --note="emergency +10 for incident 5055550000"
```
kim_sre: done. Cancel returned 20 jobs evicted. Pool update accepted, new max=130.
alex_runtime: triggering repack job (non-disruptive try first, then hard if needed): ```bash
redwood repack start --pool=gpu-pool-prod-eu --strategy=fast-consolidate --dry-run=false --parallel=4
```
alex_runtime: repack started, estimate 8m. monitoring placer logs.
kim_sre: queue growth flattening: pending=182 -> 98 in 5m. latency for text-gen-3b 95p dropped from 2.8s -> 1.1s.
nina_cx: updating customers: initial status note sent to impacted tenants, telling them we're mitigating and will follow up with RCA.
sam_ic: good. assign followups: alex to own repack and kernel logs, tara to validate model quality after repack (ensure no regression), devon to liaise with cost/finance for temporary replicas, kim to do postmortem and pager notes.
devon_infra: Finance approved emergency +10 for 30m. keep monitoring.
tara_ml: quick check: embeddings appear unaffected in accuracy; no evidence of degraded outputs from switching routing.
kim_sre: closing pager for now but keeping thread open. will create incident doc and postmortem link. If anyone sees re-growth ping @kim_sre. :white_check_mark:
sam_ic: add action: investigate why autoscaler hit quota — is it a static limit, or did a runaway request spike earlier? we should correlate with deploys.
alex_runtime: preliminary: a recent cluster restart left several MIG devices in suboptimal slice sizes (2G vs expected 4G), so allocator couldn't pack pods needing 4G slices; combined with a short burst from a data backfill, autoscaler reached configured max. followup: adjust MIG sizing validation in bootstrap and add repack on boot.
kim_sre: last state: pending=12, no errors for 10m. repack completed, stranded_slots -> 3. marking incident as mitigated at 5055550102.
incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: GPU scheduling backlog reduced, autoscale restored to normal. Postmortem requested (owner=kim_sre).
